description: Hyperbolic volumes used by the MostowRigidity class instances in the encounter chapter.  Vol(4_1) computed via the Clausen-function identity at 50 decimal digits (Vol(4_1) = 2 · Cl_2(pi/3)); Vol(5_2) at 50 dps from SnapPy ManifoldHP 3.3.2 (replaces the 15-dps AHW-1991 anchor whose digits 13-15 were a transcription error).  Source of truth for the Lean literals MostowRigidity.figureEight.volume / .mostow_gap and MostowRigidity.knot5_2.volume via the :leanval[vol_4_1], :leanval[vol_5_2], :leanval[mostow_gap_4_1] tags.

data.vol_5_2_source: SnapPy ManifoldHP 3.3.2 (in-sandbox 2026-06-12); Adams-Hildebrand-Weeks 1991; cross-check: snappy-census-volume-verification witness
data.gap_note: gap_lower_bound is a conservative under-approximation of Vol(5_2) - Vol(4_1); see gap_5_2_minus_4_1_15 for the computed value at 15 dps.  Both volumes are now 50-dps (Clausen identity / SnapPy ManifoldHP).
